<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Undying Beast](/Feats.aspx?ID=5510) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

</column>

---

You can be injured by non-[silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) sources but recover with staggering speed. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points by non-silver damage and don't immediately die from a [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effect or a high [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) value, you stabilize immediately afterward. You gain the [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=99) condition as normal.
name: Undying Beast
